models.label: Wall-OSS

optimizer_work.evidence: Frozen trainer c30b8069 _update increments updates once after both actor and critic optimizer steps. Target-KL stop occurs before either step. Planned count is 14 rounds*256 transitions*10 denoising pairs/32 minibatch*1 epoch.

comparison_caveats: This reuses historical16-environment metrics; it is not a newly rerun same-time isolated baseline.
End-to-end includes simulation, RPC, likelihood verification, PPO and synchronous expert publication. No checkpoint was written before4096.
Historical per-RPC records lack absolute timestamps, so phase allocations are not reconstructed from transition counters alone.

Other local experiments ran during the historical Wall pilot; resource contention was not controlled for an environment-count-only comparison. The new64env run must disclose dedicated versus shared resource differences.
16env*16-step versus64env*4-step retain global batch256 but alter per-environment GAE truncation; this measures throughput, not equivalent learning outcomes.
A transition executes an action chunk of at most32 control steps; terminal chunks can be shorter.32*transitions is an upper bound, not an exact action count.
Simulation/inference RPC times include cross-node transport; this run does not isolate network bytes belonging to a process from host-wide network counters.

clock_alignment.method: Fixed midpoint of the envelope of measured start/end offset bounds; endpoint probes do not continuously bound intermediate clock drift. Actor sample selection is identical at both envelope extremes.

clock_alignment.basis: Phase and resource timestamps originate on the same H200 host

Local collector launched the workspace script; the separately recorded post-launch source digest is 395f9f130c7b9e2e3a6505f5a6ef7190c8734571f9dbe3858d77efaac6653cb0, not a launch-time digest. Its collection components are AST-identical to archived a6. Coverage limitation: H200 monitor began at 1794147313.611645, after inference began at 1794147198.9358027 and reached ready. H200 inference model-loading resource peaks were NOT observed or reconstructed. Remote full_monitor means only the observed monitor lifetime; remote startup means the observed remainder of initialization (including learner), NOT full service startup. Full actor-window sampling is available on both hosts. H200 GPU0 and third-party process CPU/RSS are excluded from task metrics; host-wide background counters still include unrelated activity.
models.resource_coverage_note: H200 monitoring started immediately after the learner launch, after inference was already ready. Inference model-loading resource peaks were not captured; only the sampled initialization interval and subsequent training are reported.

definitions.transition: One environment action-chunk interaction; not an episode or individual control/physics step.
definitions.training_loop_seconds: Learner run through the last complete round, including learner initialization and warmup; services are already started. Checkpoint writes are skipped.
definitions.steady_seconds: Complete post-warmup training rounds, including reset, inference, likelihood verification, optimizer work and expert synchronization.
definitions.normalized_time: Arithmetic conversion from the measured short-window throughput; not an additional 10k or long-run measurement.
definitions.rpc: Client wall time including serialization, transport and server processing. Internal encoding/denoising/GPU kernels are not separated.
definitions.hardware: 2-second samples. GPU peaks may miss short spikes. GPU capacity occupancy differs from memory-controller activity. Host counters include background work.
definitions.fairness: Different tasks, horizons, model sizes and hardware placement prevent a controlled cross-model or DSRL ranking. Historical smaller-env references also differed in contention/checkpoint overhead. Constant per-model global PPO batch changes per-environment GAE truncation.
